details:
Well, I 'm just disappointed and heart broken the devs went this far. VRChat for me was a way to make friends since I'm socially awkward and a bit of a recluse. That and my family has a history of moving and it got to the point to where I was afraid to make friends again just to lose them all over again. Then I joined VRC last year and when I did, it was a experience unlike any other. I made friends that I could connect with and talk to, and I was slowly but surely getting over my crippling social anxiety. After meeting so many people in VRC and having been through a lot on there, I was finally somewhere where I belonged somewhat. But now it's falling apart because of what's happened. I'm not trying to defend them nor am I attacking them. I'm not mad at what's happened, I'm deeply disappointed at them for restricting benevolent modding alongside the fact that they try to justify it by saying it'll solve avatar rippers and crashers when it won't. Instead of opening up new opportunities, they're restricting creativity and placing the blame on people who are trying to help make the game more playable. It's alienated the community to the point where what made VRC fun is now gone by brute forcing something that didn't even needed to be brute forced in the first place. I'm going on a boycott of VRC for a week and encourage others to do so as well as canceling your VRC+ subscriptions. Show them that it won't solve the problem, that it'll create more and be getting rid of people who enjoy it along with those who need the mods to play the game as there's people with disabilities who need some mods to help them.
And this is to the devs themselves. I want you to look at what you've done. You didn't solve a problem, you created a massive one. Most mods aren't even the problem, as it's something you took too long to realize. You caused your own downfall by stagnating on features, letting modders do the work for you and instead of trying to slowly incorporate the features or even having a steam workshop for VRC, you took it the extreme and went with a bad anti-cheat and made it unplayable for countless people. People who are either mute, deaf, or have other disabilities that inhibit what they can do and relied on the mods to get by. But now that's gone. Please... look at what you're doing and see that it'll change the game permanently. Not because of the features, but at how you turned a great portion of the community against you. People that loved the game, that could talk with friends and lay games with them, explore lovely worlds, and do things together. People that were once willing to support you. Think about it...
Delta over and out.
